basic_details.job_title: ZSI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Junior Research Fellow, Field Worker Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI), under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, is filling 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 1 Field Worker (FW) on a contract basis in the ANRF-funded project "Unraveling distinctive benthic faunal communities and their host-specific holobionts in the lesser-known Mesophotic Coral Ecosystems of India". Pay is ₹37,000 or ₹30,000 plus HRA for JRF and ₹24,000 plus HRA for Field Worker per month. Indian nationals only. Applications go by Speed Post or Registered Post to the Director, ZSI, Kolkata, and must reach by 08.12.2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for both Junior Research Fellow and Field Worker is 30 years on the last date of application. Relaxation as per government rules is 5 years for SC/ST/Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates. | Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details of each post.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the ZSI website (http://www.zsi.gov.in) or from . The form is Annexure 2 of the notice.
Fill in the prescribed form completely, stating the post name and the preference of interview (in-person or online), with a recent passport size photograph with signature pasted on it.
Attach self-attested copies of the relevant supporting documents.
Write 'ZSI-ANRF UNRAVELING MESOPHOTIC CORAL ECOSYSTEMS PROJECT & (POST NAME)' clearly on top of the envelope.
Send it by Speed Post/Registered Post to The Director, Zoological Survey of India, Headquarters, M-Block, New Alipore, Kolkata – 700 053, so that it reaches on or before 08.12.2026.
An advance copy of the application may be emailed to [email protected].
Self-attested copies of relevant supporting documents, including SC/ST/OBC certificate if applicable
Copy of SCUBA diving licence, with certification type and number of logged dives
Details of educational qualifications from Matriculation onwards and of previous employment

JRF only: title of dissertation/thesis with a one-page summary on a separate sheet; list of publications in APA style; copies of the three best scientific publications; names and complete addresses of three referees

content_sections.heading: About ZSI
content_sections.text: The Zoological Survey of India is a Government of India organisation under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, with its headquarters at M-Block, New Alipore, Kolkata. These two posts serve its ANRF-funded research project on benthic faunal communities and their host-specific holobionts in mesophotic coral ecosystems. The positions are strictly temporary/contractual and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 posts in total. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The notice prints the following for each post. The maximum age limit for both Junior Research Fellow and Field Worker is 30 years on the last date of application. Relaxation as per government rules is 5 years for SC/ST/Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Zoology/ Aquatic Biology & Fisheries/Marine Biology/ Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/Microbiology/or any other Biological Sciences or relevant degree from a recognized University with a minimum of 60% marks; and swimming skill and PADI/SSI certified Advanced Open Water SCUBA Diver with at least 25 logged dives.
rows.desirable: Marine field experience, working experience in microscopes; DNA extraction, PCR and amplification techniques and metagenomic analysis, processing of molecular data and research article publications.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University; and swimming skills and PADI/SSI certified Open Water SCUBA Diver with at least 10 logged dives.
rows.desirable: Marine field/sea going experience for biological studies.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: ₹37,000 + eligible HRA as per rules per month for candidates selected through National Eligibility Tests like CSIR-UGC NET or UGC NET (including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship) or GATE, or through a selection process via national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions. ₹30,000 + HRA as per rules per month for others who do not fall under the above. A fixed amount of ₹24,000 + eligible HRA per month as per rules. Appointments are contractual for one year initially and likely extendable up to three years based on the candidate's performance under the project. Selected candidates will be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. under a recognized university, based on eligibility and institutional affiliation, in line with the project's research objectives.

content_sections.heading: ZSI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one description of work for both the Junior Research Fellow and the Field Worker posts: Extensive on-boat field surveys and underwater SCUBA Diving explorations Collection, sorting, preservation and maintenance of marine fauna Ecological assessment of benthic fauna Collection of scientific data and processing using advanced statistical softwares; habitat mapping DNA extraction, PCR and phylogenetic analysis of molecular data; metagenomic analysis Taxonomical studies on marine benthic faunal groups Morphological and morphometric characteristics analysis under microscopes Selected candidates may be required to sail on and stay aboard long-distance fishing vessels.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ZSI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the ZSI website ( http://www.zsi.gov.in ) or from . The form is Annexure 2 of the notice. Fill in the prescribed form completely, stating the post name and the preference of interview (in-person or online), with a recent passport size photograph with signature pasted on it. Attach self-attested copies of the relevant supporting documents. Write 'ZSI-ANRF UNRAVELING MESOPHOTIC CORAL ECOSYSTEMS PROJECT & (POST NAME)' clearly on top of the envelope. Send it by Speed Post/Registered Post to The Director, Zoological Survey of India, Headquarters, M-Block, New Alipore, Kolkata – 700 053, so that it reaches on or before 08.12.2026. An advance copy of the application may be emailed to [email protected] . Self-attested copies of relevant supporting documents, including SC/ST/OBC certificate if applicable Copy of SCUBA diving licence, with certification type and number of logged dives Details of educational qualifications from Matriculation onwards and of previous employment JRF only: title of dissertation/thesis with a one-page summary on a separate sheet; list of publications in APA style; copies of the three best scientific publications; names and complete addresses of three referees

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of their total weightage of qualification and experience. Mere possession of qualification and experience may not entitle a candidate to be called for interview or selection. The interview will be held at ZSI Headquarters, M-Block, New Alipore, Kolkata – 700 053, West Bengal, in hybrid mode (physical and online). The date and time of the interview will be communicated separately by email. Original certificates and supporting documents will be verified physically during the interview and before the offer letter is issued.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 1 Field Worker (FW) in the ZSI-ANRF Unraveling Mesophotic Coral Ecosystems Project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ZSI JRF and Field Worker posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach ZSI on or before 08.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ZSI JRF?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Zoology, Aquatic Biology & Fisheries, Marine Biology, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Microbiology or any other Biological Sciences, or a relevant degree, with minimum 60% marks. Swimming skill and PADI/SSI Advanced Open Water SCUBA Diver certification with at least 25 logged dives are also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ZSI Field Worker?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University, with swimming skills and PADI/SSI certified Open Water SCUBA Diver with at least 10 logged dives.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years on the last date of application for both posts. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/Women and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the ZSI JRF and Field Worker posts?
faq.answer: JRF gets ₹37,000 + eligible HRA per month if selected through NET/GATE or a national-level examination as described in the notice, otherwise ₹30,000 + HRA. Field Worker gets a fixed ₹24,000 + eligible HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states every amount as "+ HRA" (eligible HRA as per rules) per month.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from zsi.gov.in, fill it, and send it with self-attested documents by Speed Post/Registered Post to the Director, ZSI, M-Block, New Alipore, Kolkata – 700 053, to reach by 08.12.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ZSI job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are contractual for one year initially, likely extendable up to three years based on performance, and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. How are candidates selected and is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on total weightage of qualification and experience, then interviewed in hybrid mode at ZSI Kolkata. No TA/DA will be provided for the interview.
